text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Little red dots lined up across the 
forehead just like musical notes?!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
If I just cover it with my hair for now... 
No, but then my styled hair would...

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Doloroso... Is today to be an elegy for 
me...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Sounds of Earth stood before the 
mirror, fretting over a skin breakout...
